description: Use when you need to find a company's annual report, latest quarterly report, recent 8-K events or registration statements: lists the company's recent EDGAR filings (newest first, up to the last ~1000), filtered by form type and date, each with filing date, period of report, accession number, 8-K item codes, size and direct URLs to the primary document and filing index. Insider and beneficial-owner forms (3/4/5/144/13D/13G) are excluded. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.002 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.

cik.description: SEC CIK. Give ticker or cik.

forms.description: Comma-separated form types (amendments included), e.g. "10-K,8-K". Default: 10-K,10-Q,8-K,20-F,6-K,40-F,S-1,DEF 14A,424B4. Use "all" for every company form.

since.description: Only filings on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

ticker.description: Stock ticker. Give ticker or cik.
